response.title: what do i need to build a power station
response.answer:
Building a power station depends heavily on its size, power source, and intended use. It could be a portable battery power station, a solar-powered system for a house, or a utility-scale power plant that supplies electricity to thousands of homes.

Main things you need

For most power stations, you'll need six major systems:

System

	

Purpose




Energy source

	

Solar panels, wind turbines, natural gas, hydro, nuclear, or batteries




Power generation / storage

	

Generators, turbines, battery banks, or photovoltaic systems




Power conversion

	

Inverters, transformers, rectifiers, and voltage regulation




Electrical distribution

	

Switchgear, cables, circuit breakers, and substations




Control and safety

	

Monitoring, protection relays, cooling, fire protection, and emergency shutdown




Infrastructure

	

Land, foundations, buildings, grid connections, permits, and maintenance access

Examples by scale
Shop

Portable power station

0.5–5 kWh battery capacity, typically for camping or emergency backup.

Main components: battery cells, battery management system, inverter, charger, enclosure, and electrical protection.

Shop

Home solar power station

Typically 5–20 kW of solar generation.

Main components: solar panels, inverters, optional battery storage, mounting equipment, disconnects, and electrical distribution.

Commercial or utility-scale power station

1 MW to hundreds of MW or more.

Requires land, major generation equipment, substations, grid interconnection, engineering, environmental approvals, and substantial financing.
